_about: Curated sim racing knowledge for SteamOS. Every claim lists a source. Live ratings (Steam Deck, ProtonDB, Are We Anti-Cheat Yet) are fetched at runtime and shown alongside. Status values: works, setup (works with some setup), community (community workarounds only, unsupported by the developer), broken.

games.name: BeamNG.drive
install: Install from Steam. On SteamOS the native Linux version is the default; leave 'Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool' off.
In game: Options > Other > Protocols. Enable OutGauge (IP 127.0.0.1, port 4444) and MotionSim (IP 127.0.0.1, port 4445).
Drive to a start/finish point and press 'Set start line' in Pitwall to time laps.

known_issues.text: The native version is Vulkan-only and needs a fully featured Vulkan driver.
HDR may be broken or unreliable under SteamOS Gaming Mode (Gamescope).
Native and Proton versions use different user folders, so settings and mods can seem to vanish after switching. Native folder: ~/.local/share/BeamNG/BeamNG.drive/current.
Can use more than 16 GB of memory; without enough RAM and swap the game may close.
Community report (MOZA R5): force feedback felt flatter on the native version than under Proton. If FFB feels weak, try forcing Proton as a comparison.

perf_hints: Dynamic reflections, shadow quality and the number of AI/traffic vehicles have the biggest impact on frame rate.

wheel.note: BeamNG adapts steering per car; keep the base at 900° and match it in Options > Controls > the wheel's FFB/steering settings.

games.name: Assetto Corsa
install: Install from Steam; it runs under Proton.
For telemetry, run a shared-memory bridge alongside the game (simshmbridge or winecarte). It copies the game's acpmf_* memory into /dev/shm where Pitwall reads it.
Pitwall shows 'Telemetry: waiting for bridge' until /dev/shm/acpmf_physics appears.

known_issues.text: Shared memory stays inside the Wine prefix unless a bridge runs in the same prefix as the game.
Content Manager and Custom Shaders Patch need extra setup under Proton; check recent ProtonDB reports for the current method.

games.name: Assetto Corsa Competizione
install: Install from Steam; it runs under Proton.
For telemetry, use the same shared-memory bridge as Assetto Corsa (simshmbridge or winecarte).

known_issues.text: Reported to work correctly; performance can be the limiting factor. MOZA wheels are reportedly recognised.

games.name: Assetto Corsa EVO
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
Use winecarte for shared memory; it lists AC EVO support.

known_issues.text: EVO publishes the same acpmf_* maps, but some tools report the data as incomplete.

games.name: Automobilista 2
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
Telemetry support in Pitwall is planned (via the Project CARS 2 shared memory bridge).

known_issues.text: Force feedback has been lost with some Proton versions (reported with a Logitech G29); one user restored it with GE-Proton 7-44 but lost it again after alt-tabbing.
Avoid re-plugging the wheel while the game is running; it can break controller mappings.

games.name: rFactor 2
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
Telemetry needs the rF2 Shared Memory Map plugin plus a bridge; Pitwall support is planned.

known_issues.text: Community reports say it runs; check ProtonDB for the current recommended Proton version.

games.name: Le Mans Ultimate
install: The developer lists Linux and Steam Deck as unsupported.
Community reports use a custom Proton build (GE-Proton10-4-LMU). Expect tinkering.

known_issues.text: Developer: 'MacOS, Linux and Steamdeck is unsupported at this time.'
For menu lag, community reports suggest changing 'CEF mode' in UserData/player/Settings.JSON.

games.name: RaceRoom Racing Experience
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
Telemetry support is planned.

known_issues.text: Community report: force feedback didn't work with a Logitech G29 even though the wheel worked in other games.

games.name: DiRT Rally 2.0
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
Pitwall can switch on telemetry for you: it edits hardware_settings_config.xml in the game's Proton prefix to enable UDP (extradata 3, port 20777). Run the game once first so the file exists.

games.name: Forza Horizon 5
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton (Valve rates it Playable on Steam Deck).
In game: Settings > HUD and Gameplay > Data Out: On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 5300.

known_issues.text: A game update once broke launching on Linux until Valve shipped a Proton Hotfix; if it stops launching after an update, check that 'Proton Hotfix' is selected.

games.name: Forza Horizon 4
install: Install from Steam; runs under Proton.
In game: Settings > HUD and Gameplay > Data Out: On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 5300.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
install: Install from Steam.
If it has Data Out like earlier Horizon games: Settings > HUD and Gameplay > Data Out: On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 5300.

known_issues.text: Steam Deck Verified at launch (May 2026).

games.name: Forza Motorsport
install: Check the live ProtonDB rating first; launch problems have been reported.
In game: Data Out: On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 5300.

known_issues.text: Reported to need Microsoft Gaming Services, which installs but then fails to launch the game.

games.name: Live for Speed
install: Not on Steam: download from lfs.net and add it to Steam as a non-Steam game with Proton.
In LFS's cfg.txt set: OutGauge Mode 1, OutGauge IP 127.0.0.1, OutGauge Port 4444.

known_issues.text: BeamNG's OutGauge uses the Live for Speed format, so the same Pitwall adapter reads both.

games.name: iRacing
install: Doesn't run on SteamOS: its anti-cheat isn't enabled for Linux/Proton.

known_issues.text: Listed as Broken (Easy Anti-Cheat) on Are We Anti-Cheat Yet.

games.name: EA SPORTS WRC
install: Doesn't run on SteamOS since EA anticheat was added (v1.9).

known_issues.text: EA: the game 'will not run on the native Steam OS for Steam Deck following the release of EA anticheat'.

games.name: F1 24
install: Doesn't run on SteamOS: EA Javelin Anticheat blocks Linux.

known_issues.text: Listed as Denied (EA anticheat) on Are We Anti-Cheat Yet.

games.name: F1 25
install: Doesn't run on SteamOS: EA Javelin Anticheat blocks Linux.

known_issues.text: Listed as Broken (EA Javelin Anticheat).
EA has posted a job listing mentioning future Linux/Proton support for Javelin, but nothing has shipped.
